<?php

namespace Acme\Auth;

use Acme\Cache\CacheInterface;
use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

# Keeps sessions in the cache and knows when one has expired.
class SessionStore implements SessionStoreInterface
{
    private CacheInterface $cache;
    private const TTL_SECONDS = 3600;

    public function __construct(CacheInterface $cache, LoggerInterface $log)
    {
        $this->cache = $cache;
    }

    # The session for a token, or null when it is missing or expired.
    public function find(string $token): ?Session
    {
        $raw = $this->cache->get($token);
        if ($raw === null) {
            return null;
        }
        foreach ($raw['claims'] as $claim) {
            if ($this->isExpired($claim)) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        try {
            return Session::fromArray($raw);
        } catch (\JsonException $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    # Writes the session and resets its clock.
    public function save(Session $session): void
    {
        $this->cache->set($session->token(), $session->toArray(), self::TTL_SECONDS);
    }

    private function isExpired(array $claim): bool
    {
        return $claim['exp'] < time();
    }
}

interface SessionStoreInterface
{
    public function find(string $token): ?Session;
}

trait ClockAware
{
    protected function now(): int { return time(); }
}

require "mail"
require_relative "invoice"

module Billing
  # Sends invoices, and records that it did so the job can be retried safely.
  class InvoiceMailer
    ATTEMPTS = 3

    attr_reader :transport

    def initialize(transport, logger)
      @transport = transport
      @logger = logger
    end

    # Delivers one invoice. Returns false when every attempt failed.
    def deliver(invoice)
      ATTEMPTS.times do |attempt|
        begin
          @transport.send(build(invoice))
          return true
        rescue Net::SMTPError => e
          @logger.warn(e.message)
          next if attempt < ATTEMPTS - 1
        end
      end
      false
    end

    # Whether this invoice has already gone out.
    def delivered?(invoice)
      !invoice.delivered_at.nil?
    end

    # Builds the message without sending it. Useful in previews.
    def self.preview(invoice)
      new(NullTransport.new, Logger.new(nil)).build(invoice)
    end

    private

    def build(invoice)
      Mail.new(to: invoice.email, subject: "Invoice #{invoice.number}")
    end
  end
end
